svg.title: Where recorded positions accumulate.
svg.desc: TopView_1A: all 355,206 source positions from 965 track IDs, counted in 0.25 by 0.25 metre square cells. Each cell's relative sample frequency is its count divided by all source positions. Colour is linear from zero to the largest cell's relative frequency. The largest cell contains 1,967 observations (0.5538%). This is accumulated sample frequency, not instantaneous occupancy, calibrated pedestrian density, crowd risk, or a distinct-person count.
svg.text: TOPVIEW_1A / ALL 355,206 POSITIONS / 0.25 m SQUARE CELLS
Relative sample frequency / linear colour scale / not calibrated occupancy
